note: Monthly statewide data current through May 2025. County bi-annual data current through January 2025.

monthly.fileTitle: National Data Bank Version 8.2 PUBLIC - SNAP Monthly State Participation and Benefit Summary, FY2025
monthly.note: USDA later rolled the published file back to revision -6 (coverage ends 2025-03-01), so this repo is two months ahead of what USDA currently serves.

retailers.note: Unioned across USDA releases to preserve history beyond USDA's rolling ~20-year window (which drops stores that closed long ago).

population.note: Used by prepare_web_data.py to compute per-capita SNAP participationRate per county. Needed because raw-count county maps otherwise just mirror population density.

applications.originalSourceFiles: Weekly press-release spreadsheets, e.g. wp-content/uploads/2022/04/SNAP-Data-4.1.22.xlsx ('SNAP Data by County Received and Approved')
applications.note: A COVID-era *weekly, by-county* series of applications received AND approved; the 4/1/2022 file still resolves but the next week (4/8/2022) and all later dates 404. That specific weekly/by-county slice ended. However DHS DOES publish ongoing monthly data on https://humanservices.hawaii.gov/bessd/snap/ : by-island participation (see dhs_participation) and application timeliness incl. applications received (see dhs_timeliness), both back to ~2009. So only the weekly cadence + by-county 'approved' counts are truly gone.

dhs_participation.note: Monthly by-island participation, SFY 2009-2026. History backfilled from the DHS archive via scripts/extract_dhs_snap.py (.xls via xlrd, PDF via pdftotext). Cross-validated: the July-2021 peak (206,226) matches USDA's all-time max exactly, and island parts sum to STATE. May/June 2021 missing (the SFY2021 release was partial).

dhs_timeliness.note: Application processing timeliness + applications received, FFY 2009-2026. Backfilled from the DHS archive (.xls 'STATE SUMMARY' sheets via xlrd; PDF 'State TOTAL' rows via pdftotext). Remaining gaps are source-side: FFY2025 unpublished; FFY2018/2020/2021 are mid-year partials; FFY2023 is an August-only snapshot.
